name: Wakisaka Shisui
source:
Hobbies: Jogging, canoeing.
Dislikes: Disheveled collars.

Shisui is a handsome butler who follows [url=/c127083]Kouga Genzou[/url] like a shadow.
He is a perfectionist and a rationalist who rarely shows his emotions and diligently fulfills his duties as a butler. He is also a master swordsman, his credo is that he doesn't need a taste for swords.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=933594&gc=gc]Getchu[/url].]
